# ghost/easy-dice

Easy Dice (F-Droid): roll any hand of d2, d4, d6, d8, d10, d100, d12, d20 and d30 dice for tabletop games and read the total. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/easy-dice
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/easy-dice open_dice --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/easy-dice add_dice --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/easy-dice roll --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/easy-dice reset_hand --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/easy-dice roll_dice --device <serial> --param spec=<spec>
```

## Actions

- `open_dice`: Open the Easy Dice app
- `add_dice`: Add two d20 dice to my hand
- `roll`: Roll the dice in my hand
- `reset_hand`: Clear my dice
- `roll_dice`: Roll 2d6 and a d20
